description.text:
The Pikachu Legendary Celebration gift boxes (皮卡丘传奇庆典) came out on 8 December 2023 in two versions, a Poké Ball box (精灵球礼盒) and a Great Ball box (超级球礼盒), each packed in its ball, which can be kept for storage or display. Each held one random Pikachu holo, one random holo of a Legendary or Mythical Pokémon and a random 25-card Primordial Arts pack. They were sold on Pokémon's Tmall store and in partner shops.

The Pikachu cards are a Pikachu with the artwork used when the card game began in 1996, Pikachu V using Volt Tackle, Gigantamax Pikachu VMAX, and Flying Pikachu V and VMAX and Surfing Pikachu V and VMAX, the Surfing Pikachu cards' first appearance in Simplified Chinese. The legendary cards run from Ho-Oh and Lugia to Solgaleo and Lunala; some show them with Lillie, and Zacian V and Zamazenta V appear in new types. Mew is among them, and with luck a box held a shiny gold Mew, numbered 025, past the set's 24.
